note: Fifth held-out set: 30 messages (15 scam, 15 benign) written by a third party (Gemini), covering different scam types than all earlier sets. It was NOT seen while any rule was written: round 3 and the tech-support-scam signal were finished before these messages existed, so it is the only set fully unseen at the time of final tuning. English only. Links are written as normal links (not defanged). A third-party generator tends to write hyphenated lookalike domains, which the unfamiliar-link-pressure rule targets, so results may look better than for scams with simpler domains. Synthetic, so the numbers are not a guarantee of real-world accuracy. Do not tune rules on it. Messages use the same fields as heldout3.json: { id, label, category, text }.
